test_cases.title: Registered user receives time-limited reset link
test_cases.objective: Verify that a registered user receives a time-limited password reset link via email.

steps.action: A registered user enters their email address in the password reset form and submits it.
steps.expected_result: The system generates a time-limited reset link and sends it to the user's email address via email notification, with a clear expiration time displayed in the email body or confirmation message, and the user is redirected to a confirmation page indicating the link has been sent successfully, with a message such as 'A password reset link has been sent to your email.' or 'Check your email for a password reset link.'

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Unregistered user receives same confirmation as registered user
test_cases.objective: Verify that unregistered users receive the same confirmation message as registered users when requesting a password reset.

steps.action: An unregistered user enters an email address in the password reset form and submits it.
steps.expected_result: The system displays the same confirmation message as for registered users — for example, 'A password reset link has been sent to your email.' — and sends a time-limited reset link to the provided email address, regardless of whether the user is registered or not.

source_requirements: The same confirmation is shown for registered and unregistered emails.

test_cases.title: New password satisfies password policy
test_cases.objective: Verify that the new password meets the defined password policy when resetting a password.

steps.action: A user clicks on the password reset link, enters a new password that satisfies the password policy (e.g., at least 8 characters, one uppercase, one number, one special character), and confirms the password.
steps.expected_result: The system accepts the new password and successfully updates the user's password, with a success message such as 'Your password has been successfully updated.'

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the password policy.

test_cases.title: Invalid email format results in error
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system rejects a password reset request when the email address is invalid or malformed.

steps.action: A user submits a password reset request with an invalid email format (e.g., 'invalid-email' or 'user@.com') or an empty email field.
steps.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the email is invalid or required, and does not send any reset link or proceed with the request.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Expired reset link results in error
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system does not allow a password reset if the reset link has expired.

steps.action: A user clicks on a password reset link that has expired (e.g., 15 minutes after generation).
steps.expected_result: The system displays a message such as 'The password reset link has expired. Please request a new one.' and does not allow password change.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: System handles high volume of password reset requests
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system handles a very large number of password reset requests without crashing or degrading performance.

steps.action: Simulate a high volume of password reset requests (e.g., 10,000 concurrent requests) sent to the system within a short time frame.
steps.expected_result: The system processes all requests without crashing, and each user receives a valid reset link within a reasonable time (e.g., under 5 seconds), with no significant performance degradation or error rate increase.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Email already in use by another user receives reset link
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system correctly handles a password reset request when the user's email is already in use by another account.

steps.action: A user submits a password reset request with an email address that is already registered to another user account.
steps.expected_result: The system sends the reset link to the email address, and the reset link is valid for that email, regardless of which user owns it, and the user receives the same confirmation message as for registered users.

source_requirements: The same confirmation is shown for registered and unregistered emails.
